content:
incident-bot: PAGER: auth-proxy unusual session pattern detected. 3 distinct IPs hitting /login and /token endpoints, high 401 rate, possible credential harvesting. Customers affected: a few login failures reported. auto-escalate to incidents.

alice_oncall: On it. grabbing context + checking dashboards :eyes:

ben_sre: I see spike from 3 /16s in ASN 6939, burst started ~5m ago. Rate ~120 req/s to auth-proxy.

carla_sec: Can we confirm any leaked logs or keys yet?

alice_oncall: Not yet. Logs show repeated malformed bearer tokens + long user-agent strings. No obvious key material in payloads.

frank_dev: quick grep on staging and prod: `grep -R "Authorization: Bearer" /var/log/auth/* | tail -n 50` — nothing with raw keys.

ben_sre: Applying temporary WAF block on offending IP ranges and adding strict rate-limit rule for /token. Patch pushed to edge WAF.

incident-bot: action_taken: WAF block applied -> 3 ip ranges blocked.

dave_cs: We have 2 customer tickets referencing login timeouts. I'll notify affected customers that we're investigating.

carla_sec: Prep for key rotation anyway. Which service accounts could be at risk?

alice_oncall: Only auth-proxy service token shows increased retries. Suggest rotating `svc-auth-proxy` token and any stale deploy keys.

frank_dev: Starting key rotation playbook now. Running: ```bash
# rotate service token
kubectl -n infra create secret generic svc-auth-proxy-token --from-literal=token=$(openssl rand -hex 32) --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
```

ben_sre: I'll coordinate rolling restart of auth-proxy replicas after secret update. Doing one AZ at a time.

erin_legal: Please preserve logs and timeline for possible notification. Tag alerts and export a copy.

alice_oncall: Exporting logs to secure bucket: `s3://redwood-incidents/1799004321/` with restricted ACL.

incident-bot: export_complete: logs uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/1799004321/ (restricted).

carla_sec: Also enable more verbose request logging for 30m to capture payload patterns (no sensitive dumps). Ensure PII scrubbing.

frank_dev: Verbose logging enabled with scrub filter.

ben_sre: Auth-proxy rolling restart in progress. 2/6 pods restarted.

alice_oncall: Customer impact: intermittent login failures for <1% of requests. No data exfil confirmed. CS notified 2 impacted accounts.

dave_cs: Sent update to customers: short note saying we mitigated traffic and rotating tokens, no evidence of data exposure yet.

carla_sec: Next steps: finish rotation, keep WAF blocks for 24h, run full audit of recent log exports, and schedule follow-up incident review. Assigning owners: rotation=frank_dev, audit=carla_sec, customer comms=dave_cs.

erin_legal: If we confirm any log leak or credential exposure we'll follow notification plan. Standby.

alice_oncall: I'll mark this as active incident and create a follow-up channel for postmortem. Good work team :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident_status: mitigation_in_progress -> key_rotation in progress. will auto-close when all tasks complete.

frank_dev: Rotation done. Pod restarts completed. Verifying traffic drop now.

ben_sre: Traffic from offending ASNs dropped to baseline after WAF. No new 401 flood.

carla_sec: Audit started. No sign of leaked tokens in logs. Recommend keep WAF rules 24h and rotate monitor thresholds.

alice_oncall: last update: incident downgraded -> monitoring. closing thread in 1h if stable. Thanks everyone.
